modules.title: 同一段回答怎样从事件片段变成聊天气泡
事件片段怎样组成完整回答

items.title: 片段抵达
items.text: 服务连续发来文字或状态事件，单个片段不一定是完整的一个词。

items.title: 界面追加
items.text: 产品按顺序把每个文字片段接在已有内容后面。

items.title: 等待仍在继续
items.text: 首段先出现能减轻等待感，但总时长仍取决于后续生成和传输。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 流式展示主要让内容更早可见，不会自动让模型更快完成整段回答。

lessonPractice.title: 长回答要 20 秒完成，产品想让用户更早看到内容，但还要正确处理失败和结束。怎样设计？

options.label: 接收真实流并逐段渲染，明确生成中、完成、中断和重试状态
options.feedback: 流式响应缩短首段等待，完整状态则防止把中断内容误认为最终答案。

options.label: 等完整回答返回后，再用打字机动画慢慢显示
options.feedback: 用户仍等待了全部生成时间，只是把已完成内容延迟播放，并没有更早获得结果。

options.label: 出现第一个字就标记任务完成，后续内容在后台随缘追加
options.feedback: 首段可见不代表回答结束，过早完成会破坏复制、保存和错误处理。

en.title: A long answer takes 20 seconds, and the product wants earlier visible content while handling failure and completion correctly. How should it work?

options.label: Render a real stream incrementally with generating, complete, interrupted, and retry states
options.feedback: Streaming reduces time to first content, while explicit states keep interrupted output from looking final.

options.label: Wait for the complete answer, then reveal it slowly with a typewriter animation
options.feedback: Users still wait for full generation and then receive an artificial delay rather than earlier content.

options.label: Mark the task complete at the first character and append later content in the background
options.feedback: First content is not completion, and premature state breaks copying, saving, and error handling.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请接入真实流式响应，逐段更新同一条消息，并区分连接中、生成中、完成、中断和重试。首段出现不能标记完成；中断时保留已生成内容并说明状态，支持用户停止生成。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Use the real response stream to update one message incrementally and distinguish connecting, generating, complete, interrupted, and retry states. First content is not completion; preserve partial output on interruption and allow stop.

learning.assumes: You have watched a chat answer appear word by word or in pieces.
learning.outcome: You can distinguish a fast first piece from the total time to finish an answer.

modules.title: How response pieces become one chat bubble
How events form a complete response

items.title: Pieces arrive
items.text: The server sends text or status events; one piece may not be a complete word.

items.title: The interface appends them
items.text: The product adds each text piece in order to the existing content.

items.title: Generation continues
items.text: Early content reduces perceived waiting, but total time still depends on the rest.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: Streaming makes content visible sooner; it does not automatically make the model finish the whole response faster.
